transcript.text: Good afternoon, everyone. Thank you for joining this medication-safety huddle. As you know, the hospital introduced the intravenous anticoagulant protocol on Monday, and we need to complete our safety review before it's used on the night shift. Please report your operational findings, I'll record each requirement, and then I'll come back around to confirm before I sign off. Let's start with pharmacy — what are your findings?
